title: PatchRail CI Classes
description: Machine-readable inventory of the failure classes PatchRail can diagnose locally, emitted by patchrail ci classes --format json. The documented use is coverage checking from a script, so `unknown` — the result ci explain returns when no rule matches — is reported under `fallback` and kept out of `classes`/`count`: every entry of the denominator is a class the classifier can actually reach.

classes.description: Every failure class the classifier can return from a matching rule, in stable rule order. `unknown` is not one of them.

count.description: Number of entries in `classes`. Always equal to its length.

fallback.description: The sentinel ci explain returns when no rule matches. Not a diagnosable class: never counted in `classes`/`count`.
